methodology: Each label rests on a checkable public fact, not on judgement. 'authentic' entries are official institutional accounts (the organisation verifies its own identity). 'inauthentic' entries must come from a documented source (platform takedown notice or published research dataset) and record that source in label_source; none are included yet because no such list has been verified against these account ids.

run_requirements.note: Scoring this set needs one collection run per account. 6 seed entries require ~84 provider credits, which exceeds the balance available when this file was written. The set is therefore NOT yet scored and no accuracy figure exists.

accounts.notes: Verified news organisation publishing under its own brand.
Analysed across tasks 7-16; consistent first-person Bengali posting history, no coordination evidence. Labelled authentic by manual review - a weak label source, recorded as such.

exclusions: No 'inauthentic' examples are shipped: inventing a bot label would defeat the purpose of the benchmark. Add them from a platform transparency report or a peer-reviewed dataset, recording the citation in label_source.
